title: Remove @payloadcms/plugin-mcp from externals if plugin is removed
body: If @payloadcms/plugin-mcp is removed from plugins/index.ts entirely (not just disabled via MCP_ENABLED=false), remove it from webpackConfig.externals in next.config.js.
rationale: Keeping unnecessary externals is harmless but unnecessary cleanup.

title: Consider adding get-tsconfig to serverExternalPackages too
body: get-tsconfig is currently only in webpackConfig.externals for non-client builds. It could also be added to serverExternalPackages in next.config.js to prevent Next.js from bundling it into serverless functions.
rationale: Reduces bundle size for serverless functions and further ensures the package is never analyzed in client context.
